messages.subject: Project Vertex - royalty & milestone model
messages.plaintextBody:
Gregory,

For the board pack - the royalty and milestone model reflecting the current terms (upfront, milestones to £54m, tiered royalties 6/9/12%). The projection tab is illustrative on net sales; the milestone and assumptions tabs set out the contractual triggers. Shout if you'd like the net-sales ramp flexed.

James
